Figure 5. 

AvrStb6 confers protection against bacterial antagonism across genetic backgrounds and modulates fungal–bacterial dynamics. 

Figure 5A. Fungal inhibition caused by Pseudomonas and Pantoea co-cultivated with five Z. tritici strains: IPO323, IPO323 ∆AvrStb6, 3D7-mCherry, 3D7-mCherry ∆AvrStb6, and 3D7-mCherry AvrStb61E4. 

```{r}

# Load necessary libraries
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)
library(readr)
library(rstatix)
library(dplyr)
library(multcompView)
library(tidyverse)

```


```{r}

# 1. Load and prepare data

df <- read_csv("Pseu_and_Pant_vs_Zt_strains.csv")

treatment_labels <- c(
  "IPO323" = "IPO323",
  "IPO323_AvrStb6" = "IPO323 ΔAvrStb6",
  "3D7" = "3D7-mCherry",
  "3D7_AvrStb6" = "3D7-mCherry ΔAvrStb6",
  "3D7_AvrStb6_1E4" = "3D7-mCherry + AvrStb6.1E4"
)

df <- df %>%
  mutate(treatment = factor(treatment, levels = names(treatment_labels)))

df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    bacteria_genus = factor(bacteria_genus,
                            levels = c("Pseudomonas", "Pantoea"))
  )

letters_df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    bacteria_genus = factor(bacteria_genus,
                            levels = c("Pseudomonas", "Pantoea"))
  )


# 2. Statistics: ANOVA and Tukey per bacterial genus

anova_results <- df %>%
  group_by(bacteria_genus) %>%
  anova_test(inhibition_length ~ treatment)

tukey_results <- df %>%
  group_by(bacteria_genus) %>%
  tukey_hsd(inhibition_length ~ treatment) %>%
  ungroup()


# 3. Compact letter display

letters_df <- tukey_results %>%
  group_by(bacteria_genus) %>%
  group_modify(~ {
    comp <- setNames(.x$p.adj, paste(.x$group1, .x$group2, sep = "-"))
    let <- multcompLetters(comp)$Letters
    
    tibble(
      treatment = names(let),
      letters = unname(let)
    )
  }) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(treatment = factor(treatment, levels = names(treatment_labels)))

letter_positions <- df %>%
  group_by(bacteria_genus) %>%
  mutate(offset = 0.06 * diff(range(inhibition_length, na.rm = TRUE))) %>%
  group_by(bacteria_genus, treatment) %>%
  summarise(
    y = max(inhibition_length, na.rm = TRUE) + first(offset),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

letters_df <- letters_df %>%
  left_join(letter_positions, by = c("bacteria_genus", "treatment"))


# 4. Box Plot with variable defined

p <- ggboxplot(df,
               x = "treatment",
               y = "inhibition_length",
               fill = "treatment",
               color = "treatment",
               add = "jitter",
               facet.by = "bacteria_genus",
               width = 0.7,
               alpha = 0.4,
               outlier.shape = NA) +
  
  geom_text(data = letters_df,
            aes(x = treatment, y = y, label = letters),
            inherit.aes = FALSE,
            size = 5,
            vjust = 0,
            family = "Avenir Next Medium") +
  
  scale_x_discrete(labels = treatment_labels) +
  
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, NA),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.15))
  ) +
  
  labs(x = "Zymoseptoria tritici isolate",
       y = "Inhibition length (mm)") +
  
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    text = element_text(family = "Avenir Next Medium"),
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 10),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 11),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "black"),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA)
  )


#---------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Save plot
#---------------------------------------------------------

ggsave("Pseu_and_Pant_vs_Zt_strains.png", p, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 600)
```
